description: I’m a Data Scientist with experience in AI/ML, Python, Predictive Modeling, Data Analysis, Statistics, and Data Visualization. I aim to build an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring and early-warning system for NASA Space Apps. I’m looking for team members interested in AI/ML, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Statistics to collaborate on this project.
summary:
AstroGuard AI – AI-Powered Astronaut Health Monitoring System

AstroGuard AI is an artificial intelligence-based health monitoring system designed to support astronaut safety during space missions. The project focuses on analyzing astronaut physiological and biological data to identify abnormal health patterns and predict potential health risks.

Using NASA's publicly available OSD-575 dataset, which contains blood serum metabolic panel and immune/cardiac cytokine measurements from the SpaceX Inspiration4 mission, the system explores machine learning techniques for health-risk analysis.

The project uses Python, data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and Random Forest-based supervised learning to identify patterns associated with astronaut health conditions. Its goal is to support early risk identification, improve health monitoring, and provide data-driven insights that can assist mission safety decisions.

Primary Objective: To explore how AI and machine learning can contribute to astronaut health monitoring and help improve the safety and reliability of future space missions.
details:
AstroGuard AI – AI-Powered Astronaut Health Monitoring System

AstroGuard AI is an AI/ML-based research prototype designed to explore astronaut health monitoring during space missions. It uses NASA's OSD-575 dataset from the SpaceX Inspiration4 mission, containing blood serum metabolic and immune/cardiac cytokine measurements.

How it works: The project uses Python for data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and Random Forest-based machine learning to explore biological patterns and potential health risks.

Benefits and Intended Impact: It aims to support early identification of unusual health patterns and contribute to safer, data-driven astronaut health research.

Tools and Technologies: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Random Forest, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Jupyter Notebook, Git and GitHub.

Creativity and Innovation: It applies machine learning to space-health research by analysing multiple biological indicators to explore meaningful patterns.

Factors Considered: Data quality, missing values, class imbalance, model reliability, overfitting, interpretability, and astronaut safety.

Vision: To establish a foundation for intelligent astronaut health monitoring and support future human space exploration.
